name: Boots of Striding and Springing
description: Long boots of red leather with a spring in their heels.
body:
## What they do

While you wear them you walk at least 30 feet a round, and neither heavy loads nor heavy armor slow you. Every jump carries you three times as far as it would, though never further than you have movement left.

features.name: Springing
features.text: You jump three times the normal distance, within your remaining movement. Encumbrance and heavy armor do not slow you.
